'''Veril Line Systems''' was an ancient<ref name="Extras">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021017web|text=''Arms & Equipment Guide'' Extras!}}</ref> and well respected [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer.<ref name="EGTD" /> The company had a corporate heritage of producing superior [[Industrial droid/Legends|industrial droids]],<ref name="Extras" /> with their greatest impact being in the [[Construction droid/Legends|construction]], [[Power droid/Legends|power]],<ref name="EGTD" /> and [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] fields.<ref name="Extras" />

The corporation preferred functionality in their products over appearance, and had never produced military equipment such as droids, munitions, or [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Because of this stance, Veril Line Systems had good relationships with the various galactic and planetary governments that were active over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Their main headquarters were located on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Extras" />

Veril Line's construction droids helped to shape the Coruscant skyline.<ref name="EGTD" /> During the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the company fielded a [[Nuna-ball/Legends|nuna-ball]] team consisting of [[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga]] droids. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Veril's team beat [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] team of [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP droids]] with a score of 76-59.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>

Veril Line Systems manufactured a variety of droid models,<ref name="EGTD" /> and their products were available on any [[Planet/Legends|world]] that maintained a [[Stellar-class starport]]. The [[EG-series power droid/Legends|EG-series power droid]] was one of their staple lines,<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> including the first power droid brought to the market, the [[EG-4 power droid|EG-4]],<ref name="FF14">{{FactFile|12|POW 1-2|Power Droids}}</ref> and the common [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 unit]] which was effectively the company's mascot.<ref name="Extras" />

Other products included the [[EVS Construction Droid]], the [[Gyrowheel 1.42.08-series recycling droid]],<ref name="EGTD" /> the [[IN-4 information droid]],<ref name="CFTD" /> the [[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga-222 maintenance droid]],<ref name="NEGTD" /> the [[S9-series heavy power droid]],<ref name="CFTD" /> the [[V5-T transport droid]],<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> and the [[I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid/Legends|I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid]].<ref name="CFTD" />
